metadata.question: Does Dorsoidong Co Lake have a lighter blue color than Chibzhang Co Lake in October 12, 1987?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - I need to compare the color of two lakes on October 12, 1987. - Dorsoidong Co Lake and Chibzhang Co Lake are both in the Tibetan plateau region. - I'll use Landsat 5 TM data (available from 1984 onwards) for this historical date. - Location: Dorsoidong Co is roughly at (32.8°N, 89.5°E), Chibzhang Co is roughly at (33.0°N, 88.5°E). 2. Masking strategy: - For visual color comparison (blue color), I should use the visible spectrum bands: Red (B3), Green (B2), Blue (B1) for Landsat 5. - "Lighter blue" suggests higher reflectance in blue wavelengths relative to red/green. - I'll calculate a "blue intensity" metric or compare the blue band reflectance directly. - No cloud masking needed for the specific lakes if they're cloud-free on that date. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - If no Landsat 5 image exists for Oct 12, 1987 at either lake, output C1. - If images exist but pixels are masked/invalid (C2). - If calculation returns None/NaN or invalid values (C3). - Compare blue band values: if lake 1 has higher blue reflectance, it's "lighter blue" → A (Yes). - Otherwise → B (No). ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define lake locations (approximate centers) const dorsoidong = ee.Geometry.Point([89.5, 32.8]); const chibzhang = ee.Geometry.Point([88.5, 33.0]); // Buffer for regional analysis const buffer = 5000; // 5km buffer const dorsoidong_region = dorsoidong.buffer(buffer); const chibzhang_region = chibzhang.buffer(buffer); // Target date: October 12, 1987 const date_start = '1987-10-10'; const date_end = '1987-10-14'; // Landsat 5 TM collection const col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(date_start, date_end); const count_total = col.size().getInfo(); print(`Total Landsat 5 images (Oct 10-14, 1987): ${count_total}`); if (count_total === 0) { print('No Landsat 5 images found for this date range.'); print('C1'); return; } // Get image for this date const img = col.first(); if (img === null) { print('Image is null.'); print('C1'); return; } // Landsat 5 TM bands: B1=Blue, B2=Green, B3=Red // Use SR_B1 (Blue) for color comparison const blue_band = 'SR_B1'; const red_band = 'SR_B3'; const green_band = 'SR_B2'; // Calculate blue intensity (blue reflectance) const dorsoidong_blue = img.select(blue_band) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: dorsoidong_region, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }) .get(blue_band) .getInfo(); const chibzhang_blue = img.select(blue_band) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: chibzhang_region, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }) .get(blue_band) .getInfo(); // Check pixel counts const dorsoidong_count = img.select(blue_band) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: dorsoidong_region, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }) .get(blue_band) .getInfo(); const chibzhang_count = img.select(blue_band) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: chibzhang_region, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }) .get(blue_band) .getInfo(); print(`Dorsoidong Co - Blue: ${dorsoidong_blue}, Pixels: ${dorsoidong_count}`); print(`Chibzhang Co - Blue: ${chibzhang_blue}, Pixels: ${chibzhang_count}`); // Validation checks if (dorsoidong_count === 0 || chibzhang_count === 0) { print('No valid pixels for one or both lakes.'); print('C2'); return; } if (dorsoidong_blue === null || chibzhang_blue === null || isNaN(dorsoidong_blue) || isNaN(chibzhang_blue)) { print('Calculation returned invalid value.'); print('C3'); return; } // Compare blue values // Higher blue reflectance = lighter blue color if (dorsoidong_blue > chibzhang_blue) { print(`Dorsoidong Co has lighter blue (${dorsoidong_blue.toFixed(2)} > ${chibzhang_blue.toFixed(2)})`); print('A'); } else { print(`Chibzhang Co has lighter blue or equal (${chibzhang_blue.toFixed(2)} >= ${dorsoidong_blue.toFixed(2)})`); print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
